name: lokalise
label: Lokalise
description: Lokalise is a collaborative translation platform.

token.label: API Token
token.description: Lokalise API Token. You can generate one from your Lokalise account.

createComment.label: Create Comment
createComment.description: Add comments to a key in your Lokalise project

comment.label: Comment
comment.description: The comment text to add to the key

createProject.label: Create Project
createProject.description: Create a new project in your Lokalise team

baseLangIso.label: Base Language ISO
baseLangIso.description: Language/locale code of the project base language (e.g., "en", "en-us")

teamId.label: Team ID
teamId.description: ID of the team to create a project in (numerical ID or UUID). If omitted, the project will be created in your current team

createTask.label: Create Task
createTask.description: Create a new task in your Lokalise project

description.label: Description
description.description: Brief task description. Used as instructions for AI in automatic_translation and lqa_by_ai task types

keys.label: Key
keys.description: Comma-separated list of key IDs to include in the task (required unless parent_task_id is specified)

languages.label: Languages
languages.description: Comma-separated language ISO codes for the task (e.g., "fr,de,es")

sourceLanguageIso.label: Source Language ISO
sourceLanguageIso.description: Source language code for the task

dueDate.label: Due Date
dueDate.description: Due date in format: Y-m-d H:i:s (e.g., "2024-12-31 23:59:59")

autoCloseLanguages.label: Auto Close Languages
autoCloseLanguages.description: Whether languages should be closed automatically upon completion. Default is true

autoCloseTask.label: Auto Close Task
autoCloseTask.description: Whether the task should be automatically closed upon all language completion. Default is true

closingTags.label: Closing Tags
closingTags.description: Comma-separated tags to be added to keys when task is closed

doLockTranslations.label: Lock Translations
doLockTranslations.description: If set to true, will lock translations for non-assigned project members

markVerified.label: Mark Verified
markVerified.description: Mark translations as verified. Only for automatic_translation tasks. Default is true

saveAiTranslationToTm.label: Save AI Translation to TM
saveAiTranslationToTm.description: Save AI translations to Translation Memory. Only for automatic_translation tasks

applyAiTm100Matches.label: Apply AI TM 100% Matches
applyAiTm100Matches.description: Apply 100% translation memory matches. Only for automatic_translation tasks

deleteKey.label: Delete Key
deleteKey.description: Delete a key from your Lokalise project (software and marketing projects only)

retrieveAComment.label: Retrieve a comment
retrieveAComment.description: Retrieve a specific comment on a key in your Lokalise project

retrieveAKey.label: Retrieve a key
retrieveAKey.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific key in your Lokalise project

disableReferences.label: Disable References
disableReferences.description: Disable key references in the response

retrieveAProject.label: Retrieve a project
retrieveAProject.description: Retrieve detailed information about a Lokalise project

retrieveTranslation.label: Retrieve Translation
retrieveTranslation.description: Retrieve a specific translation from your Lokalise project

disableReferences.label: Disable References
disableReferences.description: Disable key references in the translation

updateKey.label: Update Key
updateKey.description: Update properties of a key in your Lokalise project

keyName.label: Key Name
keyName.description: Key identifier (or JSON with ios, android, web, other for per-platform names)

platforms.label: Platforms
platforms.description: List of platforms enabled for this key

mergeTags.label: Merge Tags
mergeTags.description: Enable to merge specified tags with current tags

isHidden.label: Is Hidden
isHidden.description: Whether this key is hidden from non-admins

context.label: Context
context.description: Optional context of the key (used with some file formats)

charLimit.label: Character Limit
charLimit.description: Maximum allowed number of characters in translations

updateTranslation.label: Update Translation
updateTranslation.description: Update a translation in your Lokalise project

translation.label: Translation
translation.description: The actual translation content. Use JSON object format for plural keys

isUnverified.label: Mark as Unverified
isUnverified.description: Whether the Unverified flag is enabled

isReviewed.label: Mark as Reviewed
isReviewed.description: Whether the Reviewed flag is enabled

custom_translation_status_ids.label: Custom Translation Status IDs
custom_translation_status_ids.description: Comma-separated custom translation status IDs to assign (existing statuses will be replaced)
